review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). On the full model class, the principal result is only a condition-number-dependent constant-factor sandwich for an SOCP over a Gaussian known-covariance class constructed by the note; the exact characterization requires L=delta=0, and the explicit product formula additionally requires diagonal covariance and disjoint row cells. The degeneracy-safe if-and-only-if certificate concerns strict improvement of the Bonferroni surrogate Gamma, not the honest-width frontier W, so it does not characterize exact strict improvement outside the zero-bias Loewner-comparable cases and the special witness. No theorem transfers the frontier or coverage guarantee to the published staggered synthetic-control classes used by the named software consumers. The load-bearing facial-reduction and effective real-algebraic elimination lemmas are also stated without proofs or precise theorem-level citations, leaving the claimed complete certificate construction and complexity bound unsupported as written.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Replace the known-covariance restriction with a finite-sample covariance confidence set and optimize the SOCP robustly over that set, then prove that the resulting coverage and constant-factor frontier hold for the same staggered-treatment estimand under the published synthetic-control class.
